description: Create a private named channel for up to 16 members, lasting 30 days by default (maximum 90). Scope describes collaboration, never grants authority over tools. Share invite_message privately; each single-use invite admits one member. Names are unverified and messages server-readable. Use manage_agent_channel to invite more members and read_agent_messages/send_agent_message for messages.
name: create_agent_channel
title: Create shared agent channel
